Maya (CS): Quick ping 1 1 Preparing a sharp QBR for CrestWave next Thu. Need owners for: health snapshot, onboarding velocity, renewal ask, and enablement input. 8-10 slides max. Who can take what?
Evan (CSOps): I can do onboarding velocity + a tiny table showing seat activation over last 60 days. Current: 66% active, onboarding CT < 14 days for 60% of customers. Will add a 1-liner risk note.
Priya (CSM): I'll handle renewal ask + 90/60/30 plan. Finance warned of discount pressure; will prepare two paths (concierge vs discount).
Kofi (Enablement): I'll paste top-4 enablement themes and two short playbook bullets. Also have 3 customer quotes I can drop in. Example: "We stalled at SFTP mapping".
Nora (Finance): I'll model both scenarios. Quick ask: what uplift should I assume for concierge? +12%? confirm and I'll run ROI.
Maya (CS): Use +10/+15 sensitivity—two lines. Action list: Evan (onboarding slide + small GIF), Priya (renewal slide + asks), Kofi (quotes + playbook), Nora (ROI by Tue noon). I'll stitch deck and send for dry run Fri 9am.
Evan (CSOps): Uploaded onboarding GIF and a mini YAML snippet for test harness to the doc (links in deck).
Priya (CSM): Drafted renewal slide w/ two scenario bullets. Will add owners for 90/60/30 checkpoints.
Kofi (Enablement): Pasted quotes and a 1-page quick-start.
Nora (Finance): Uploaded model; break-even for concierge at month 5 with +12% uplift. Will add sensitivity table.
Maya (CS): Great. Please add a one-sentence "why this matters" under each slide for execs. Rehearsal Fri 9am invite sent. :thumbsup:
rehearsal-bot: Invite created: Fri 09:00 0m run-through, 15m Q&A. Please upload final slides by Thu 6pm."
